text.arabic_uthmani: إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

words.gloss_range: retrospective temporal subordinator that embeds the brothers' speech as the selected sign-scene

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: speech verb introducing the brothers quoted utterance

words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) opens retrospectively: the ayah asks the reader to enter the moment when the brothers spoke. It frames {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) as a recalled origin-point, so jealousy becomes visible as a quoted speech event rather than as narrator summary. The boundary also reaches back to the sign-frame of 12:7; this is the concrete family scene selected as one of those signs.

topics.headline: retrospective speech-scene opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the brothers' complaint as the selected remembered moment where jealousy becomes speech.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb subordinates the following speech scene and foregrounds the utterance as a narrative occasion.

topics.headline: boundary hinge from the prior sign frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this speech is not free-floating; it instantiates the prior ayah's sign-frame (12:7).
topics.reason: The boundary rows tie the opener back to 12:7, where the Joseph-and-brothers material has just been announced as signs.

words.gloss_range: completed plural speech act introducing the brothers' collective complaint and its quoted clauses
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, and voiced report; here the perfect plural introduces the brothers as a collective speaking agent
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) introduces the brothers as a plural voice already fused into one completed utterance. Because the following clauses all belong to the quotation, the verb controls the ayah's perspective: their comparison, their group boast, and their verdict are all their speech. The root of saying becomes action here; the complaint creates the accusation that will carry into the command of 12:9. Surah-level echoes keep this voice unstable: the same preference field is reversed in Yusuf's words at 12:33, and the group-strength formula returns in the brothers' later speech at 12:14.

topics.headline: completed plural group utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the brothers first as a fused speaking group, not as individually named debaters.
topics.reason: The perfect 3mp form carries the plural subject inside the verb and presents the utterance as completed.

topics.headline: saying functions as plot action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their saying does not merely report jealousy; it performs the accusation that drives the next move.
topics.reason: The quoted content moves from ranked love to verdict, so the speech act becomes the mechanism of conspiracy.

topics.headline: speech echoes through preference and group claims
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track this complaint as the first collective voice in a larger surah pattern of claims, excuses, and reversals (12:14; 12:33).
topics.reason: The rows give same-surah echoes where speech, preference, and group self-authorization recur.

topics.headline: speech carries into the next imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speech opening as the runway into the next ayah's command, not a sealed complaint.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect the quoted complaint in 12:8 with the imperative continuation in 12:9.

words.prose: The first {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) fuses emphasis directly to {{ar:يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:Yūsufu}}), so Yusuf's name is loaded before the predicate of love is even heard. That fronting makes the person himself the grievance-focus. The later emphatic {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) before {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) answers it, giving the ayah two assertion peaks: first the preferred child, then the father's alleged error. The repeated short particle also makes those two peaks audible.

topics.headline: emphasis fused to the named grievance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels Yusuf named under pressure before the comparison itself arrives.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle is prefixed to the proper name, focusing assertion on the person before the predicate appears.

topics.headline: two assertion peaks bracket the complaint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the complaint has two emphatic peaks: the loved child first, the error verdict last.
topics.reason: The first emphatic particle at the name is answered by the later predicate particle before the error phrase.

topics.reason: The phonetic row gives a local sound payoff tied to the two assertion peaks.

words.prose: {{ar:يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:Yūsufu}}) is not a descriptive root-word but a fixed foreign proper name, and it stands as the foregrounded subject of the comparison. The brothers put that name first, before the brother, the father, or themselves, so the grammar enacts the hierarchy of grievance. The name has just belonged to the sign-frame in 12:7; here it is pulled into human resentment, and by 12:9 the same named focus is ready to become the object of the proposed command.

topics.reason: The nominative proper name is the subject of the elative predicate and is pulled forward under emphasis.

topics.reason: The rows connect the local naming to 12:7 and the surah-local concentration of the name.

topics.headline: named grievance becomes next target

words.prose: This {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds {{ar:أَخُوهُ}} ({{tr:akhūhu}}) to {{ar:يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:Yūsufu}}) as a distinct co-subject. The result is a two-person favored side, which makes the later contrast with the brothers' group claim sharper. Locally, the first connector adds a person, while the later {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the speakers' circumstance; the repeated particle therefore divides addition from counterclaim. Its light syllable also makes the added brother arrive as a small audible step after Yusuf's name.

topics.headline: brother added as distinct co-subject

topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the brother with Yusuf as co-subject of the elative predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:أَخُوهُ}} ({{tr:akhūhu}}) names the brother only through Yusuf: the suffix makes him {{ar:يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:Yūsufu}})'s brother, not an independently introduced figure. Its five-nouns nominative form is grammatically marked and lets the kinship relation share the subject role with Yusuf. That matters for the argument: the brothers are not just complaining about one beloved child, but about a compact dyad set against {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) and {{ar:عُصْبَةٌ}} ({{tr:ʿuṣbatun}}). Its glottal opening and long ū make the added kinship word audible after the clipped connector, while the boundary from 12:7 narrows the broad brothers-frame into this one dyadic relation. Later brother-language reverses the force of this label, especially when Yusuf discloses the bond to his brother in 12:69 and the brothers weaponize sibling association again in 12:77.

topics.headline: brother defined through Yusuf
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second favored person is not independently named; he is grammatically attached to Yusuf.
topics.reason: The possessed singular and suffix make the brother definite through Yusuf.

topics.headline: irregular kinship morphology carries the relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees formal kinship grammar carrying the social grievance, while local reference keeps the sense to Yusuf's specific brother.
topics.reason: The five-nouns nominative and root-shape rows are valid morphology, but the local suffix narrows broad brotherhood to the concrete sibling relation.

topics.headline: one sibling bond faces the plural bloc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the argument's geometry: one named person plus one possessed brother against the speakers' collective self.
topics.reason: The singular possessed noun helps build the dyad that is contrasted with the later plural group.

topics.headline: kinship label later turns from grievance to recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the brother-word from resentment into later recognition and weaponized accusation (12:69; 12:77; 12:90).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows show the same kinship field reappearing in later brother scenes with reversed force.

topics.headline: kinship word is audibly and narratively marked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the brother term as a marked addition and sees the prior brothers-frame narrow into one specific brother.
topics.reason: The sound row and boundary row both preserve the word's marked local entry after the connector.

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَبُّ}} ({{tr:aḥabbu}}) is the hinge of the first claim. As an elative predicate, it makes love measurable: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) names the father's perspective and {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) names the lower comparatum. The singular predicate can rank the Yusuf-brother dyad as one favored side. The love root contributes a sense of attachment and concentration, but locally the construction selects comparative belovedness rather than a broad root survey. The brothers then turn that ranked affection into evidence for their verdict. The same preference field is morally reversed when Yusuf says prison is more beloved to him in 12:33. The rare elative form and doubled b sound compress the grievance into one marked preference word.

topics.headline: elative turns love into measured rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees affection converted into a grammatical ranking, with evaluator and lower comparatum both supplied.
topics.reason: The elative predicate governs the relation to the father and the comparison with the speakers.

topics.headline: affection becomes evidence for error
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers use love-language as proof in an accusation, not as a neutral emotional report.
topics.reason: The argument moves from comparative love to the final error verdict.

topics.headline: attachment and concentration color the preference

topics.reason: Root-image rows add affective pressure, but the local ADJ_COMP construction selects ranked preference rather than every branch of the root.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare the brothers' jealous ranking with Yusuf's later moral ranking in 12:33.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows tie the same comparative field to later preference language with opposite moral valence.

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) narrows from ordinary direction into the relation of estimation: the dyad is more beloved to, or in the sight of, the father. The directional overtone still helps the complaint feel like nearness to the father, but local grammar keeps the function as evaluator-marking. Together {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) make the preference measurable: first the father's perspective, then the brothers as the compared side.

topics.headline: direction narrows to relational estimation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition points to the father as evaluator, with a residual nearness overtone but not literal motion.
topics.reason: With the elative adjective, the preposition marks the person in whose estimation the dyad is beloved.

topics.headline: prepositions make the comparison measurable

topics.reason: The paired prepositional phrases complete the comparative relation around the predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:أَبِينَا}} ({{tr:abīnā}}) is definite by the brothers' possessive suffix, so the comparison is about our father in their mouth, not fatherhood in general. Its genitive five-nouns form is governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), placing the father as evaluator in the love ranking. Broader father/source pressure matters because the brothers treat his affection as an allocation of status, but local grammar keeps the referent to the immediate shared father. The same father will be repeated as {{ar:أَبَانَا}} ({{tr:abānā}}), shifting from evaluator to defendant; that case-shift is the ayah's move from premise to verdict. Later father-language in the surah returns through authority and reunion, including 12:80 and 12:100. The repeated -nā sound in the father word, the comparison, and the later verdict keeps the brothers' collective claim audible.

topics.headline: possessed father anchors the comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the father as the brothers' claimed shared authority, not a generic parent.
topics.reason: The possessed genitive noun is governed by the preceding preposition and identifies the evaluator in the comparison.

topics.headline: fatherhood carries source and allocation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels paternal love as an allocated source of honor, while the local noun keeps the referent to the immediate father.
topics.reason: Broader father/source senses color the grievance, but the possessive noun narrows it to the household father.

topics.headline: evaluator becomes later defendant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's argument pivot: the father first evaluates love, then is indicted as erring.
topics.reason: The same possessed father appears first as genitive object of the estimator phrase and later as accusative subject of the verdict.

topics.headline: father-root forms the narrative spine

topics.reason: Inter-ayah rows show father language recurring through later negotiation and restored honor.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) closes the comparison by making the brothers the lower comparatum: the dyad is more beloved than us. The suffix compresses group identity into one small comparative word, then {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) will expand that same first-person plurality into an explicit subject. The source-sense of the preposition can lightly color the complaint as separation from the favored pair, but local grammar selects comparison. Its nasal sound also links the compressed us to the surrounding first-person plural chain.

topics.reason: The form compresses comparison and first-person plurality, and the sound links it to the surrounding plural possessives.

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from comparison into counterclaim. It can be heard as and, but the local clause works circumstantially: while we are a band. That makes {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) {{ar:عُصْبَةٌ}} ({{tr:ʿuṣbatun}}) evidence inside the brothers' argument. The same connector that earlier added the brother now introduces the group's social credential, and the cadence moves from a light link into a heavy collective noun.

topics.headline: while-we clause sharpens contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the group claim as a circumstance that makes the father's preference seem more objectionable to the speakers.
topics.reason: The connector introduces a nominal circumstantial clause with the explicit pronoun and group predicate.

topics.headline: second premise joins the argument

words.prose: {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) makes the speakers' collective self explicit. Earlier they were present as suffixes in {{ar:أَبِينَا}} ({{tr:abīnā}}) and {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}); here the group becomes the subject before its credential is named. Because the clause is nominal, the brothers present groupness as standing identity, not as a temporary action. Its nasal sound sustains the same first-person thread heard in the possessive and comparative forms.

topics.reason: The independent pronoun stands as subject of the nominal group claim.

words.prose: {{ar:عُصْبَةٌ}} ({{tr:ʿuṣbatun}}) is the brothers' strongest self-credential. It is a collective singular, so many speakers are packaged as one band, and the root image of binding and wrapping makes the claim more forceful than simple plurality. The standard nominative parse makes it the predicate of {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}); the accusative variant is meaningful as a circumstantial reparse, but it does not displace the local predicate reading. The word answers the Yusuf-brother dyad with a bound group, and that same boast returns almost verbatim in 12:14. Its rarity and tight sound texture make the self-label feel marked rather than casual.

topics.headline: collective singular packages many as one band
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the brothers claiming not just number but a single consolidated social body.
topics.reason: The nominative collective singular predicates group identity of the explicit pronoun.

topics.headline: variant tests identity versus circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a real recitational pressure point, while the standard local parse keeps the word as predicate identity.
topics.reason: The accusative variant can construe the group term circumstantially, but the local QAC-compatible parse is nominative predicate.

Because the same clause later contains {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), certainty is stacked: their grammar insists on what the story will later destabilize. The doubled n sound also leads directly into the -nā of the possessed father noun.

words.prose: {{ar:أَبَانَا}} ({{tr:abānā}}) repeats the possessed father term inside the verdict. Now the father is no longer the genitive evaluator of love but the accusative subject governed by {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}). The case shift from {{ar:أَبِينَا}} ({{tr:abīnā}}) to {{ar:أَبَانَا}} ({{tr:abānā}}) tracks the brothers' reasoning: the one to whom the dyad is beloved becomes the one they accuse of being in error. Broader father-as-source pressure heightens the charge, but the local form remains a kinship noun, not a refusal verb. The suffix keeps the indictment relational: they judge our father. The repeated -nā sound reaches its accusatory peak here, attached to the very person being judged.

It does not simply reassert the father; it intensifies the phrase that says he is in error. Fused with {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), the particle binds certainty to containment. It also answers the opening {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), so the complaint is framed by two human assertion peaks whose confidence is stronger than their judgment.

words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes error a containing state. The brothers do not merely say the father made one bad choice; they place him inside an enclosing condition. words.prose: {{ar:ضَلَالٍ}} ({{tr:ḍalālin}}) is the core of the accusation. As a gerund inside {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), it names a state of straying rather than labeling the father directly as a strayer or claiming an outside misleader. The lost-path image remains active, but locally it is narrowed to cognitive and moral misjudgment about paternal preference. Its indefiniteness leaves the error broad, while the following adjective tightens it into a claimed manifest condition. The heavy sound and paired ending help make the brothers' verdict feel grave, even though it is their human judgment.

words.prose: {{ar:مُبِينٍ}} ({{tr:mubīnin}}) closes the ayah by modifying {{ar:ضَلَالٍ}} ({{tr:ḍalālin}}), not the father directly. As a Form IV active participle, it lets the brothers present the error as manifest and even revealing; the claim sounds proof-like, but no proof has been supplied. The root's separation and distinction image fits their sense that right judgment is plainly apart from the father's preference, yet local agreement keeps the word as an adjective for the error noun. Surah 12 later reworks clarity-language in different moral settings: Satan is an obvious enemy in 12:5, public accusation recurs at 12:30, and recognition arrives in 12:100. Here the final word is the brothers' claimed obviousness, sealed by the -in cadence and then carried across the boundary into the command of 12:9.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison at word 5, the two father references at words 7 and 12, the group claim at word 10, and the verdict at words 14-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers measure paternal affection against collective solidarity and presumed usefulness. Because the larger mutually supporting group receives less love than the favored pair, they treat the allocation itself as a visible departure from the proper course.

activation_trace.role: Heart-abiding preference supplies the literal affection being treated as a scarce family resource.
Fatherhood and nurture identify the office whose differential care the speakers judge.
An encircling, mutually supporting group supplies the brothers' counterweight to the favored pair.
Departure from right direction supplies their judgment that the father's preference violates the proper course.
Manifest appearance makes the judgment sound self-evident rather than merely resentful.

changed_reading.before: The brothers complain that their father loves Yusuf and his brother more.
changed_reading.after: The complaint is a distributive accusation: collective strength is made the expected measure of paternal love, so preference for the pair is declared visibly misaligned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular brother relation at word 4, heart-centered love at word 5, the bound group at word 10, and separation at word 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah sets two forms of attachment against one another: a close sibling dyad held at the heart and a larger band held by mutual binding. The band's utterance draws a boundary inside the family, so its complaint about unequal attachment simultaneously performs a new separation.

activation_trace.role: Literal kinship supplies the favored dyad within the wider sibling set.
The heart's inner core spatializes the pair as occupying the center of paternal regard.
Tight binding and winding give the larger group a materially compact form.
Separation after connection supplies the boundary that the comparison creates within the household.

changed_reading.before: Two brothers are preferred over the rest.
changed_reading.after: The ayah maps a conflict between a heart-centered dyad and a tightly bound coalition; the coalition's protest itself widens the family separation it names.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural saying at word 2 and the combined error-and-clarity predicate at words 14-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural speech converts private hurt into a shared position. Once the group has said it together, the final claim of manifestness lets consensus function as evidence, closing inquiry by presenting a contested judgment as already visible.

activation_trace.role: Saying as a held position turns the utterance into the coalition's common doctrine.
Deviation supplies the substantive charge around which the speakers align.
Disclosure and visibility convert the aligned charge into an asserted fact.

changed_reading.before: The brothers report an obvious error.
changed_reading.after: Their plural speech manufactures a shared certainty: agreement within the band is made to stand in for proof that the father is wrong.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The favored heart-position at word 5 and the loss/hiddenness inventory activated by the accusation at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Although the grammar locates error in the father, the loss and hiddenness branches allow the grievance to carry the speakers' own felt condition. The favored pair occupy the center of regard, while the coalition experiences itself as missing from view and projects that displacement onto the father's judgment.

activation_trace.role: The inner heart supplies the center from which the speakers feel displaced.
Hiddenness gives the accusation a secondary image of being absent from paternal sight.
Loss supplies the speakers' felt displacement while they grammatically assign defect to the father.
Separation makes their felt exclusion legible as a relational rather than merely cognitive wound.

changed_reading.before: The father has plainly lost the right path in his preference.
changed_reading.after: The charge may also project the brothers' own felt loss: they experience themselves as absent from the center of paternal regard and rename that displacement as the father's defect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated markers of visibility place the brothers' emphatic verdict inside a field of competing disclosures. The book is manifest, the warned-of enemy is manifest, Joseph and his brothers are signs, and then the father's error is called manifest; the last claim can therefore disclose the speakers even while asserting something about the father.

activation_trace.role: Manifestness supplies the focus claim's force and the feature whose authority becomes contested.
Deviation remains the charge that the speakers insist has become visible.
Prior manifest disclosure supplies a higher-order use of the same visibility language.
The manifest adversary supplies a second competing object of obviousness before the brothers' verdict.
A visible sign reframes the brothers' conduct and speech as evidence to be read.

structural_cues: The same closing adjective marks the book in 12:1, the adversary in 12:5, and the brothers' allegation in 12:8.
Immediately before the focus, 12:7 frames Joseph and his brothers as signs for questioners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated visibility language and a sign-reading frame; I infer that 12:8 can reveal the assertors as well as describe the father. A live alternative is that the repetition only intensifies three unrelated predicates.

changed_reading.before: The final adjective simply confirms that the father's error is obvious.
changed_reading.after: The phrase remains the brothers' verdict, but it also becomes a visible sign of their own posture: certainty is dramatized, not automatically ratified.

context_deltas.mechanism: A private dream report is followed by a warning that disclosure to the brothers could provoke contrivance. The plural saying in the focus, later followed by one speaker revising the group's proposal, can then be heard as an internal caucus in which shared grievance is converted into negotiable action.

activation_trace.role: Mutual discussion supplies a deliberative function for the brothers' plural speech.
The mutually supporting band supplies the social body within which deliberation can become coordinated.
The dream supplies the guarded disclosure that precedes and motivates the warning about sibling response.
Contrivance and stratagem supply the anticipated direction in which sibling resentment may move.
One speaker's intervention displays actual negotiation inside the speaking group.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from father-son disclosure in 12:4, to a ban on retelling in 12:5, to plural speech in 12:8, to one member amending the plan in 12:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a guarded dream, an explicit warning of a plot, and a later intra-group amendment; I infer that the focus speech is a caucus opening rather than a neutral report. It could instead be a narrator's summary of complaints voiced at different times.

changed_reading.before: The brothers voice a spontaneous shared complaint.
changed_reading.after: Their complaint is the opening motion of a deliberative process: guarded knowledge activates a coalition that turns comparison into a plot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding promise of selection, teaching, and completed favor supplies a vocational trajectory that the brothers do not name. Their affective metric may register a real differentiation while misclassifying its cause as arbitrary paternal error.

activation_trace.role: Preference is the brothers' explicit explanation for the perceived asymmetry.
Paternal nurture supplies the human relation through which the differentiation is perceived.
Selection and drawing near supply a non-affective reason for Yusuf's distinct position.
Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the teaching trajectory attached to that selection.
Completion supplies the long arc of favor that exceeds a momentary emotional preference.

structural_cues: The promise of selection, instruction, and completed favor in 12:6 lies between the dream warning and the brothers' comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a declared trajectory of election and formation; I infer that paternal closeness may partly track discernment of that trajectory. The live alternative is ordinary unequal affection with no such causal link.

changed_reading.before: The father irrationally prefers two sons.
changed_reading.after: The brothers may correctly perceive differentiation but wrongly reduce a trajectory of selection and formation to favoritism, making their diagnosis narrower than the asymmetry they observe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The band's self-description becomes operational capacity. Alternatives of killing and casting away are negotiated, a concealing hollow is selected, and dispersed opinions become settled resolve; collective strength therefore enables the removal that the grievance demands.

activation_trace.role: Mutual surrounding and support supply the collective body that can coordinate coercive action.
Tight binding gives the coalition a material image of many agents acting as one.
Taking life supplies the most extreme proposed use of the coalition's capacity.
Casting something until it lies discarded supplies the moderated but still coercive alternative.
A depression in which something disappears supplies the selected mechanism of removal.
The unlined cut well supplies the concrete receptacle for the group's decision.
Firm resolve gathered after divided opinion converts coalition into an executable decision.

structural_cues: The branchless casting command at 12:9 word 4 stands beside killing as an initial option.
One speaker modifies the plan in 12:10, and 12:15 records the group moving with settled resolve into the chosen act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group binding, proposed actions, amendment, concealment, and settled resolve; I supply the causal arrow that coalition strength makes coordinated removal feasible. A live alternative is that the strength claim is only a comparison of sons, not a mobilizing boast.

changed_reading.before: Being a strong band is evidence that the father should prefer them.
changed_reading.after: Being a strong band is also the means by which preference can be forcibly rearranged; the self-description mobilizes the capacity that carries complaint into action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers answer the father's alleged deviation by planning a literal displacement: remove the favored son, make paternal attention empty for themselves, place Yusuf far after or behind, and hide him in a cut hollow. The semantic field of loss is transferred from accusation to engineered condition.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness supplies a latent dimension of the defect the brothers assign to the father.
Loss supplies the condition that the brothers subsequently impose on Yusuf.
Emptied space supplies the desired clearing of paternal attention after Yusuf's removal.
The face and what lies ahead materialize the paternal attention the group wants exclusively turned toward itself.
Causing distance supplies the temporal and relational world the brothers imagine after Yusuf.
Concealment from sight turns the focus root's latent hiddenness into a planned physical state.
A hollow that receives something supplies the spatial instrument for making Yusuf absent.

structural_cues: The proposed sequence in 12:9 is removal, exclusive paternal attention, and a new condition after Yusuf.
The concealment proposed in 12:10 is enacted with the same location in 12:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accusation with loss branches and a plan of distance, emptying, concealment, and enclosure; I infer an externalization in which perceived relational disorder is solved by manufacturing actual absence. The sequence can also be read as ordinary motive and means without deliberate root-image reversal.

changed_reading.before: The father is lost because he directs love wrongly.
changed_reading.after: The accusation anticipates a reversal: the brothers try to cure the father's supposed loss of direction by making the beloved son literally lost, hidden, and distant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact group identity returns inside a conditional about failing to protect Yusuf. What first supported a claim to greater love becomes a standard that would make the speakers deficient if harm occurred; solidarity is now a binding liability as well as a boast.

activation_trace.role: The supporting coalition initially supplies the brothers' claimed qualification for preference.
The repeated coalition image becomes the premise that should make loss under their watch impossible.
General deficiency names what their own strength standard would expose if their protection failed.

structural_cues: The same first-person group formula appears in 12:8 and 12:14, first beside a claim to preference and then inside a conditional of failed custody.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition and the consequence of deficiency; I infer that the second use tests and binds the first use as a competency claim. It may alternatively function only as reassurance to the father.

changed_reading.before: Our solidarity proves that we deserve more affection.
changed_reading.after: Our solidarity also binds us to protect: the boast creates the very standard under which our coming story of failure should condemn us.

context_deltas.mechanism: The private comparative position becomes the premise for a public campaign of reassurance. The same group asks for trust, claims purity from deceit, promises guarding, and later insists on verbal truth; the focus speech thus begins a sequence in which language is used to obtain custody and manage belief.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative speech supplies the internal formation of the position later presented to the father.
A new plural address turns internal deliberation into outward persuasion.
Settled trust names the psychological state their persuasion seeks from the father.
Purity from fraud supplies the self-characterization intended to remove suspicion.
Guarding supplies the concrete assurance by which the group seeks custody.
Truth of speech supplies the final verbal credential invoked when their account is difficult to believe.

structural_cues: Private plural speech in 12:8 is followed by plural address to the father in 12:11, a protection promise in 12:12, and an explicit truth claim in 12:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech sequence aimed at securing trust and custody; I infer that the focus grievance is rhetorically productive, not merely expressive. The later deception does not require the initial perception of unequal love to have been insincere.

changed_reading.before: The focus records what the brothers resent.
changed_reading.after: The focus also generates a persuasive program: shared resentment is organized into claims of trustworthiness, purity, guardianship, and truth that obtain control of Yusuf.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers who call error manifest later construct an evidentiary scene under conditions of low visibility: night arrival, performed tears, false material, inward beautification of the plan, and a narrated description. Their confidence in what is clear is thereby mirrored by an attempt to make a false account look clear.

activation_trace.role: False or attributed saying remains only a latent risk in the focus but becomes activated by the later fabricated account.
Revealing meaning by speech or sign supplies the evidentiary function the brothers later imitate.
Night darkness and reduced visibility supply the setting for a manufactured appearance.
Affected weeping supplies performed emotion as support for the account.
Contradiction of truth identifies the material token as false evidence.
The self's beautification of an act supplies the inward construction behind the outward display.
Presenting a thing through its attributed features supplies the narrative layer of the staged proof.

structural_cues: The brothers arrive at night in 12:16 and combine emotion, an object, and verbal description across 12:16-18.
The father distinguishes the displayed account from the inward process that made the act attractive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies low visibility, affected crying, false evidence, self-beautification, and description; I infer an epistemic reversal in which those asserting obviousness later manufacture obviousness. These details could instead be only the mechanics of the later lie, without reflecting back on the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: The brothers confidently identify a fact that is clear to them.
changed_reading.after: Their claim of clarity anticipates their own evidentiary practice: they will stage signs so that a desired description appears manifest even when it is false.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the focus saying and is not a lexical translation of the verb. It remains worth carrying because its smallness image is visibly activated by the ayah's favored pair versus encircling plurality; downstream prose should mark it as split-root wordplay or formal resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening saying at word 2 is packet-mapped to a smallness branch, while words 5 and 10 explicitly oppose greater love to a coalition.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and fewness give the opening speech a form-distant image of the favored minority.
Preference supplies the unequal value assigned to that minority.
The surrounding coalition supplies the many against whom the favored few are counted.

changed_reading.before: The brothers say that two sons are loved more than they are.
changed_reading.after: As a contained formal activation, the utterance voices the scandal of fewness outranking mass: the favored minority outweighs the organized many.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The grain image belongs to a branch of the love root rather than the adjectival sense in context, so this is not an etymological gloss of the focus word. It remains anchored because the beloved is subsequently placed in a receiving hollow and the pickup verb carries a grain-gleaning branch; downstream prose should render it only as a material metaphor activated across scenes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The love word at 12:8 word 5 carries a seed/grain branch that later meets the hollow and pickup at 12:10.

activation_trace.role: A grain that germinates supplies a latent material image for the beloved son.
A hollow receiving an object supplies the seed-like placement produced by the brothers.
Gleaning grain after harvest supplies the surprising recovery image attached to Yusuf's pickup.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf is the more-loved child whom the brothers want removed.
changed_reading.after: In a contained material reading, the beloved becomes seed-like: put into a hollow by the coalition yet positioned to be gleaned rather than erased.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is an anticipatory cross-domain activation, not a claim that 12:8 directly mentions the later garment. It remains unusually well anchored because the focus inventories include object-signification for saying and disclosure by signs, while the later falsehood inventory specifically includes a garment that lies by its condition; downstream prose should qualify it as a material echo of the brothers' speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The saying at word 2 and manifestness at word 15 are reactivated when a later garment is made to signify a false account.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying through indication extends the focus speech into the later use of material testimony.
Disclosure by word or sign supplies the standard of apparent clarity that the object is made to imitate.
The garment supplies the physical sign recruited to tell the brothers' account.
A garment that lies by its condition supplies the exact counterfeit-material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The brothers verbally pronounce the father's error manifest.
changed_reading.after: Their speech anticipates counterfeit material speech: a garment will be made to 'say' a false story through its condition, imitating the clarity they claim in the focus.

strongest_changes: The coalition claim shifts from evidence of deserving love to the operational capacity for coordinated removal.
The accusation of paternal loss reverses into a plan that makes Yusuf physically lost, hidden, and distant.
Manifestness shifts from an apparently ratified verdict to a contested sign and then to a staged evidentiary practice.
The grievance becomes both a response to guarded selection and the premise of a campaign for trust and custody.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive latent activations were the non-dominant fewness target against the many, the love-root's grain image meeting later gleaning, and object-signification meeting the branch of a garment that lies by its condition.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus plural speech may be an internal caucus, but the packet does not explicitly locate its audience.
Paternal love may track discerned selection and formation, or the preceding promise may only reframe an otherwise ordinary preference.
The split-root, seed, and speaking-garment readings are branch-backed resonances rather than lexical senses of the focus forms.
Repeated manifestness may deliberately turn judgment onto the speakers, or it may be emphatic recurrence without that reflective function.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Clinging love is misread through compact group strength.** ح ب ب B002 (love as clinging attachment) is measured against ع ص ب B004 (encircling, mutually supporting group). I infer that the brothers convert affection into a scarce allocation because they treat numerical solidarity as the proper basis of value. `أحب` thus becomes the trigger for a distributive grievance.
2. **Their accusation may expose their own hiddenness.** ض ل ل B001 (straying from aim) names their claim about the father, while B002 (being hidden/disappearing) is activated by their inability to see the dream-governed trajectory. This does not transfer the adjective grammatically; it adds an exploratory irony anchored in `ضلال`: the speakers who declare error are themselves screened from the operative relation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:91 corrected the brothers’ diagnosis: they acknowledged divine preference and their own خطأ, reversing who had actually missed the right course.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Solidarity that encloses and distorts.** `ع ص ب:B004` is “an encircling, mutually supporting group,” including paternal kin and factional solidarity; `ع ص ب:B002` retains the material image of tightening and binding. The brothers oppose their compact “we” to two singled-out sons, then move as a bloc from diagnosis to removal (12:9-10) and collective trust claims (12:11-12). The packet supplies the enclosure; I infer that cohesion amplifies a shared misjudgment by making strength its own evidence. *ʿUṣbah* thus reads critically as tightly bound factional perception, not simply numerical strength.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:80 repeats private collective withdrawal, while 12:91 dissolves the brothers' earlier factional claim in confession; solidarity proves capable of both enclosing judgment and becoming a forum for its correction.

baseline.text: Bir zaman kardeşleri, "Yusuf ve kardeşi babamıza bizden daha sevgili, oysa biz güçlü bir topluluğuz. Babamız açık bir yanılgı içindedir" dediler.

findings.text: Kardeşlerin sıkı grup dayanışması, gücü değer ölçüsü sayarak sevgiyi kıt ve paylaşılması gereken bir kaynak gibi görmelerine yol açar.
Babalarını yolunu şaşırmış sayarken kendilerinin olayların gerçek yönünden gizli kalması, suçlamayı konuşanlara döndüren bir ironi oluşturabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı dayanışan topluluğu, baba yanından erkek yakınları, bir araya gelme, destek çağrısı ve bir şeyin çevresini kuşatmayı birlikte doğrular.

lexicalization_scope.note: Topluluk adları ile akrabalık, destek ve çevresinde dönme yapıları ayrı yüzler olarak verilir; özel akrabalık sınırı bütün topluluklara yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Birbirine destek veren veya bir merkez çevresinde toplanan insan ya da hayvan topluluğudur. İnsanlarda baba yanından erkek yakınları ve mirasçılar özel bir tür oluşturur; birlikte hareket etme ve kendi topluluğunu desteklemeye çağırma da bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: İnsan, at veya kuşlardan oluşan, bir arada duran ve dayanışabilen topluluktur.
İnsan topluluğu için on ile kırk arasındaki sayı sınırı aktarılır.
Bir erkeğin baba yanından erkek yakınları ve erkek mirasçıları özel akraba topluluğunu oluşturur.
Toplanmak, bir merkezin çevresini kuşatmak ve kendi topluluğunu desteklemeye çağırmak bu birlik fikrinden gelişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli büyüklükte insan topluluğunu, insan ve hayvan kümelerini, baba yanından erkek yakınları ve mirasçıları, toplanma ile çevreleme hareketini ve topluluğa destek çağrısını birlikte verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العصبة من الناس، والعصابة من الناس والخيل والطير، واعصوصب القوم إذا اجتمعوا، وعصبة الرجل من قرابته لأبيه وورثته، والعصبية والتعصب بمعنى الاجتماع والنصرة، وما يطيف أو يستكف حول شيء كالقوم بفلان أو الإبل بالماء أو الغبار بالجبل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العصبة من الناس: ما بين العشرة إلى الأربعين (jamhara;sihah;tahdhib)؛ عصابة من الطير ويجمع عصائب (jamhara)؛ عصبة الرجل: بنوه وقرابته لأبيه (sihah)؛ العصابة: الجماعة من الناس والخيل والطير (sihah;tahdhib)؛ اعصوصب القوم: اجتمعوا وصاروا عصائب (sihah)؛ عصبة الرجل فهم أولياؤه الذكور من ورثته (tahdhib)؛ العصبية: أن يدعو الرجل إلى نصرة عصبته (tahdhib)؛ كل شيء استدار بشيء فقد عصب به (tahdhib;maqayis)؛ العصبة: جماعة متعصبة متعاضدة (mufradat)؛ العصبة والعصابة من الناس والطير والخيل (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه يوم عصيب ويوم عصبصب واعصوصب اليوم بمعنى اشتد، وشدة الأمر الذي يضم القوم أو يشتد عليهم.

branches.branch_image_ar: جوع وفقر ويبس يربط الجوف والفم
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المعصوب أو المعصب بمعنى الجائع أو الفقير أو من أكلت السنون ماله، ومن يعصب بطنه من الجوع، وعصب الريق بالفم إذا يبس من عطش أو تعب أو اجتمع على الأسنان.

branches.branch_image_ar: شد قهري يستدر أو يسقط أو يجمع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عصب فخذ الناقة أو منخريها لتدر، والناقة العصوب التي لا تدر حتى تعصب، وعصب الشجرة أو السلمة بضم أغصانها ليسقط ورقها، وعصب أنثيي الدابة أو التيس حتى يسقطا، والمثل في العطاء على القهر.
يدخل فيه اعتصاب التاج أو العمامة، وتعصيب الرجل أو تسويده قومه، والمعصب أو المعمم بمعنى المسود، وما سمي به ذو العصابة.
يدخل فيه العصبة نباتا يتلوى على الشجر أو هنة تلف على القتادة ولا تنزع إلا بجهد، وما شابه ذلك من الالتفاف واللزوم.

branches.branch_image_ar: قوة منحوتة من عصب وصلب وعصل
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العصلبي بمعنى الشديد أو الشديد الباقي عندما يفسر بأنه منحوت أو مزيد اللام من عصب وصلب وعصل وشدة العصب.
يدخل فيه العصب في العروض، وهو تسكين اللام من مفاعلتن ونقله إلى مفاعيلن.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı açığa çıkarma, sözü açık olma ve anlatım yetkinliği çevresindedir. Geçici çerçeve doğru olmakla birlikte bu dalın genel görünme dalından ayrı tutulması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; anlam açıklama çekirdeği ile açık sözlü kişi kalıbı ayrı ama bağlı kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlamı söz, yazı, işaret veya düzgün anlatımla açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır; kişide açık ve düzgün konuşma yetisi olarak da kullanılır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, kastedilen anlamı açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır.
Bu açıklama sadece konuşmayla değil yazı, işaret veya başka gösterme yollarıyla da olabilir.
Kişi için açık, düzgün ve etkili konuşma yetisi anlamı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı açığa çıkarma ve sözü açık olma alanında birleşir; bazıları düzgün konuşmayı, bazıları ise konuşmadan daha geniş açıklama yollarını vurgular.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أبين من فلان أي أوضح كلاما منه (maqayis)؛ البين من الرجال الفصيح (ayn)؛ البيان الفصاحة واللسن (sihah)؛ البيان الكشف عن الشيء وهو أعم من النطق (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.

branches.branch_image_ar: انفراج العضو أو الشيء عن ملاصقه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.
يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.

branches.branch_image_ar: الوقت الواقع أثناء حال أو فعل
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بينا وبينما إذا جعلتا بمنزلة حين وأضافتا الجملة إلى زمن الفعل.
يدخل فيه بين بين: ما كان بين الجيد والرديء، أو الهمزة المخففة بين الهمزة وحرف اللين، أو الضعيف غير المعتد به في الشاهد.
يدخل فيه تطليقة بائنة، أي طلاق فاعلة فيه بمعنى مفعولة يدل على انقطاع الرجعة.
يدخل فيه غراب البين بوصفه الغراب الذي يتشاءم به للفراق في الخبر اللغوي.
